verdict.rationale: Raygun documents real-time deployment tracking to spot new errors or regressions, a Deployments API, and filtering or segmenting errors by version, so it covers per-release error visibility in a basic way. Nothing in the evidence shows release-health metrics or side-by-side release comparison. Missing for 10: crash-free sessions/users metrics, per-release adoption tracking, canary-vs-stable release comparison, independent or hands-on corroboration.
